events.title: Alan Shearer scores a hat-trick as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 레스터 시티 4–3 at home in the league.

맨체스터 유나이티드 lose their defence of the FA Cup with a 1–0 fourth round replay defeat to 윔블던 at Selhurst Park . Marcus Gayle gave 윔블던 the lead, and Peter Schmeichel looked to have saved United with a last-minute goal, but it was ruled offside. This means that United will not be playing in the FA Cup final for the first time since 1993.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 pay a club record £2.3million for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 striker Paul Kitson .
레스터 시티 defender Neil Lewis is sentenced to six months in prison for affray after being found guilty of attacking a man with a bottle in a nightclub brawl.
블랙번 로버스 sign OB Odense and Denmark striker Per Pedersen for £2.5million.

The latest FA Cup upset sees Premier League 노팅엄 포리스트 eliminated 1–0 by Division Two 체스터필드 at Saltergate , while on the same day fellow Premier League club 리즈 유나이티드 suffer a 3–2 embarrassment at home to Division One 포츠머스, and Division One 버밍엄 시티's FA Cup hopes are ended with a 3–1 home defeat by Division Two surprise package 렉섬.
윔블던 pull of their second surprise win of the month when a Vinnie Jones goal gives them a 1–0 league win over 아스널 at Highbury.
Manager Hans Westerhof is sacked by 흐로닝언 .
Dave Bassett leaves 크리스털 팰리스 to take over as manager at 노팅엄 포리스트 .

Steve Coppell is appointed as 크리스털 팰리스 manager for the third time since 1984. February ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the Premier League and 리버풀 now their nearest contenders, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 아스널 and 애스턴 빌라 complete the top five. The bottom three main unchanged from the last month-end. 볼턴 원더러스 remain top of Division One, their nearest rivals now being 울버햄프턴 원더러스 who are 10 points behind them in second place. The top six is completed by 반즐리, 셰필드 유나이티드, 노리치 시티 and 크리스털 팰리스.
